NEW YORK STATE SENATE

THE STENOGRAPHIC RECORD

ALBANY, NEW YORK

June 23, 2009

3:00 p.m.

EXTRAORDINARY SESSION SENATOR ANDREA STEWART-COUSINS, Acting President ANGELO J. APONTE, Secretary

P R O C E E D I N G S

(Whereupon, at 3:00 p.m., the Acting President gaveled the session to order, discussions were held off the record, and the Senate stood at ease at 3:19 p.m.)

(Whereupon, the Senate reconvened at 4:21 p.m.)

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text: Senator Smith.

turns.label: SENATOR SMITH
turns.text: Madam President, have we received the proclamation from the Governor's office? I'd like to have that read.

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text: The Secretary will read.

turns.label: THE SECRETARY
turns.text:
"Proclamation.

"Pursuant to the power vested in me by Article IV, Section 3 of the Constitution, I hereby convene the Senate in Extraordinary Session at the Capitol, in the City of Albany, on the twenty-third day of June, two thousand nine, at three p.m., for the purpose of considering legislation with respect to various subjects.

"Given under my hand and the privy seal of the State, in the City of Albany, this twenty-second day of June in the year two thousand nine, David A. Paterson, Governor."

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text:
The proclamation having been read, the Senate returns to extraordinary session.

And the record should reflect a quorum of all 62 Senators present in the chamber when we began this extraordinary session at 3:00 p.m. today.

Senator Smith.

turns.label: SENATOR SMITH
turns.text:
Yes, thank you, Madam President.

Madam President, I move that we have an immediate meeting of the Rules Committee in the Majority Conference Room, and that we stand at ease until such time as we return.

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text:
There will be an immediate meeting of the Rules Committee in the Majority Conference Room, Room 332.

The Senate will stand at ease pending the report of the Rules Committee.

(Whereupon, the Senate stood at ease at 4:22 p.m.)

(Whereupon, the Senate reconvened at 4:32 p.m.)

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text:
The Senate will come to order.

Majority Leader Smith.

turns.label: SENATOR SMITH
turns.text:
Yes, Madam President. May we return to the order of reports of standing committees.

I believe there is a report of the Rules Committee at the desk, and we move for its immediate adoption.

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text:
Senator Smith, there is a report of the Rules Committee at the desk.

The Secretary will read.

turns.label: THE SECRETARY
ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text: Senator Smith.

turns.label: SENATOR SMITH
turns.text: Yes, Madam President. I move the adoption of the Rules Committee report.

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text:
All those in favor of adopting the report of the Rules Committee please signify by saying aye.

(Response of "Aye.")

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text:
Opposed, nay.

(No response.)

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text:
The report of the Rules Committee is adopted.

Senator Smith.

turns.label: SENATOR SMITH

turns.text: Section 2. This act shall take effect on the first of the month next succeeding.

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text:
Call the roll.

(The Secretary called the roll.)

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text: Announce the results.

turns.label: THE SECRETARY
turns.text: Ayes, 62. Nays, 0.

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text:
The bill is passed.

The Secretary will continue to read.

turns.label: THE SECRETARY
turns.text: Calendar Number 14, by the Senate Committee on Rules, Extraordinary Session Senate Print Number 325, an act to amend the Tax Law, in relation to increasing.

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text: Senator Smith.

turns.label: SENATOR SMITH
turns.text: Yes, Madam President, I believe there is a message of necessity at the desk that was sent by the Governor.

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text: Yes, Senator Smith, there is a message of necessity from the Governor that has been received at the desk.

turns.label: SENATOR SMITH
turns.text: I move that we accept that message of necessity that was sent by the Governor.

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text:
All those in favor of accepting the message of necessity signify by saying aye.

(Response of "Aye.")

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text:
Opposed, nay.

(No response.)

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text:
The message of necessity is accepted.

Read the last section.

turns.label: THE SECRETARY
turns.text: Section 3. This act shall take effect immediately.

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text:
Call the roll.

(The Secretary called the roll.)

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text: Announce the results.

turns.label: THE SECRETARY
turns.text: Ayes, 62. Nays, 0.

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text:
The bill is passed.

Senator Smith, that completes the noncontroversial reading of Extraordinary Session Calendar Number 1A.

turns.label: SENATOR SMITH
turns.text: Madam President, is there any other bills for this extraordinary session that has been sent to the desk by the Governor?

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text: The desk is clear, Senator Smith.

turns.label: SENATOR SMITH
turns.text: That being the case, Madam President, I move that now that we have finished the business that the Governor has sent forward to us for this extraordinary session today, I move that we adjourn sine die.

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS
turns.text:
The Senate will stand adjourned sine die, on motion of Senator Smith.

(Whereupon, at 6:48 p.m., the Senate adjourned sine die.)
